theorem_title: Denominator divisibility under a fixed coprime recurrence
natural_language_statement:
Let $a,b,k\in\mathbb N$, $\gcd(b,a)=1$, and $y:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$. If $b y_{i+1}=a y_i$ for all $i<k$, then

$$
b^k\mid y_0.
$$

The conclusion measures the initial divisibility needed to sustain a fixed rational multiplier.
